text.tspan: 4 processing contexts: A SPI worker · B INS0 worker · C navigation worker · D GPS task
Repeated A/B/C/D labels below refer to the SAME threads, not additional loops.

g.text: HARDWARE / NUTTX I/O — no HPWORK / LPWORK relay in the shown IMU path
IMU PATH — separate payload and wakeup wires; each arrow stays between adjacent stages
GNSS PATH — acquisition is independent; EKF2 reads GNSS during an IMU-driven run

text.tspan: TEAL: uORB publication → retained data → later read. ORANGE DASHED: schedule / wake only. GREY: device / OS I/O.
A–C each run WorkQueue::Run(): wait → dequeue → work-item Run() → repeat. C = wq:nav_and_controllers.
uORB has no central broker thread. Flat build: shared address space, not a protected kernel/user crossing.
DRDY count ≠ integration count ≠ main EKF step count. Timers, the manager and other firmware contexts are omitted.
